name: Pizza dough (direct, cold-ferment)
status: PRELIMINARY ESTIMATE — NOT COOKED OR TASTED
method: Mix to a smooth dough, bulk 1 h, divide into 230 g balls, cold-ferment 24 h at ≤ 5 °C, temper 1 h before stretching.
food_safety: Keep balls refrigerated; discard after 72 h (ASSUMPTION).
evidence: Standard bakery practice; hydration about 63% is an ASSUMPTION to be tested in the NASHA oven.
estimates_label: All quantities, yields, times and costs are preliminary estimates until a person cooks and measures them. Nothing here has been cooked or tasted.
